description: Save a search under a name, with the same filters as search_listings. It appears in the person's saved searches on evryroom.com. Needs sign-in.

areas.description: Area slugs from find_area. A home in any of them matches.

deal.description: For sale or to rent. Defaults to sale where the market has it.

max_price_eur.description: Sale price, or rent per month, in euros.

min_beds.description: Minimum bedrooms; in markets where list_markets says rooms, minimum rooms.

min_m2.description: Minimum floor area in square metres.

min_price_eur.description: Sale price, or rent per month, in euros.

name.description: What to call it, e.g. "2-bed Marina under 6k".

near.description: Only homes within a radius of a point.

setting.description: What is around the home; every one listed must hold. Only where list_markets says setting_filter.

sort.description: ppm2 sorts by price per square metre, cheapest first.

text.description: Words to find in the title or place, e.g. "penthouse" or "sea view".

town.description: A town name exactly as listings carry it.

name: save_search
title: Save a search
